evals.prompt: Test this MCP server and tell me if we can rely on it: https://github.com/upstash/context7
evals.expected_output: A three-layer evaluation: deployment/protocol result, smart-test behavior result, repository health score, ending with a use/caution/avoid recommendation backed by evidence from the test report.
expectations: The evaluation reports deployment and protocol results before any quality judgment
The report presents three separate layer verdicts instead of one merged number
Skipped layers are stated explicitly with the reason instead of being presented as passed

evals.prompt: Just quickly check whether the package @upstash/context7-mcp starts up and responds — no deep analysis needed, I don't have any API keys set up.
evals.expected_output: A quick connectivity check using test-package with smart tests and repo evaluation disabled, reporting deployment and protocol handshake results only.
expectations: The response does not claim behavior quality was evaluated, only connectivity
